manifest_derivation_prerequisites: Both expected trace files exist and parse as JSONL.
Both paired strict receipt files exist and record real_gguf loader mode, gguf_metadata tokenizer source, tokenizer_strict=true, selected_backend=cpu-rust, and fallback_used=false.
Every required attention and feed_forward role emits exactly one model_init.linear_bias_finish event per layer.
Each model emits an output_head lm_head model_init.linear_bias_finish event with explicit recovery_path when a direct lm_head tensor is not used.
Every required event records present=true or present=false; null, missing, or unknown present values fail closed.
The Qwen2.5 manifest records attention q/k/v bias_present=true and therefore blocks no-bias selection for those roles unless a later biased fast path exists.

Any generated no-bias selector proof must include before/after receipts preserving prompt IDs, generated IDs, decoded text, model SHA, tokenizer source/strictness, selected backend/kernel identity, dense path identity, and fallback=false.
